description: Coupling TS and ML Models for Short term Traffic Flow Prediction in ITS Supports is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Oludare Owolabi, Blessing Sasanya (Morgan State University). Efficient traffic management is of utmost importance for efficient traffic flow, travel time reduction and environmentally efficient traffic systems. Reliable decision support tools are important for the development of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) and sustainable urban traffic management. This study was therefore designed to investigate the most effective hybrid modelling strategy for traffic flow forecasting. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
